notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(9)': Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (posted 'WYS/This place Sucks'), Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Your Insight Serves You Well & Staging Areas; these count toward the 60.

Total is 61 as published: the section counts (9 + 1 + 15 + 4 + 1 + 5 + 24) plus the two cards under 'Epic/Admiral Order' (I Did It!, I'll Take The Leader). The 'Epic/Admiral Order' header line was removed as a card row.

Posted 'Tatooine(new)' dested the Light Coruscant-set printing Tatooine (Light) (Coruscant), as in the author's later list (DeckTech 19374); 'Cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tat Dbay' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94.

Posted 'Dash' dested the character Dash Rendar (listed under Characters); 'R2-Threepio' dested the combo character Artoo & Threepio (the strategy names Artoo and Threepio together); 'Raltiir Cptn' dested Ralltiir Freighter Captain (the strategy calls him 'RFC'); 'Theron', 'Talon', 'Pulsar' dested Theron Nett, Talon Karrde, Pulsar Skate.
Posted 'New Grabber' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred, the Light interrupt-grabber Effect from Coruscant (the newest set at the time of posting).
Posted 'Maneuvers' dested A Few Maneuvers, matching the author's later list ('Few Maneuvers', DeckTech 19374).
Posted 'Signal x2 (should be new)' is kept as The Signal; the strategy says the author hoped to add the new Coruscant interrupt We Wish To Board At Once.

Posted 'Out of Com/Tras Ter', 'Control/Tunnel', 'Sorry Bout Mess/Blaster Pro', 'Bith/Des Reach', 'Houjix/Nowhere', 'All Wings Combo', 'Insurrection/Aim High', 'Battle Plan/Draw Fire' and 'Insights/Staging' dested as the combo cards.

Posted 'R2-0 Destiny Card' and '3x Damager' (an interrupt the strategy says triples damage with Luke, Han, Artoo and Threepio; I've Got A Bad Feeling About This and Don't Underestimate Our Chances both fit) could not be matched to one card; printed as written.
